notes.title: 03/14/2019 Updates
notes.content:
Hi all! Hope you have been enjoying Ultimate Coaster X so far!!



I've released 2 updates in the past few days. They add:

[list]
[*] WASD camera controls (plus QERFTGYH for rotations, zooms, etc)
[*] Slight performance enhancements
[*] More graphical fidelity options that should allow the game to run smoother on older hardware
[*] More demo coasters (a B&M Invert, a B&M Dive, and a ripoff of StormRunner @Hersheypark)
[*] Clearer instructions for VR controls
[*] Some startup crash fixes
[*] Remap coaster editing control buttons (and add delete key to delete selected stuff)
[*] "Recenter" button for VR mode
[*] Export roller coaster models to .obj by riding them and pressing CTRL+SHIFT+E (ctrl+shift by itself will also toggle a debug menu, i probably should have mapped that to something else now lmao oops) (export directory is your windows user directory)
[/list]



Roadmap to releasing 1.0:

[list]
[*] Add Gerstlauer trains, staggerd B&M hyper trains, 4-across Intamin trains
[*] Better SFX (this one will be tough)
[*] Fix crashes (some peoples' games crash when they click "new" in the coaster window)
[*] Add friction slider to roller coasters
[*] Graphical fixes
[*] B&M dive brakes sometimes appear to float above the track
[*] B&M dive holding brake should be a chain
[*] B&M hyper chain lifts should have a return channel (i may or may not be able to figure this out)
[*] Intamin cables (hydraulic launches, cable lifts) sometimes glitch out
[*] Improve wooden support generator
[*] Water appears to glitch into the ground when zoomed out on some devices (im stumped on this one lmao, ive looked into it for hours)
[/list]
